_what: Canonical RadioAnatome anatomy registry. GENERATED by ontology.py from atlas/*/atlas.json plus atlas-pipeline/labels/*.json. Do not hand-edit: run `python ontology.py --write`.
_laterality: NONE_ASSERTED is the default and is correct for every Visible Human structure: no side is claimed anywhere in this atlas because two landmarks disagree on this cadaver. Living-patient sources may assert a side.
_confidence: GOOD = mask passed HU and position checks and has pins in a shipped module. NOT_AVAILABLE = the structure is declared but has no geometry, which is deliberate and must stay visible.
